plugins.name: Code Review Checklist
plugins.description: A reusable self-review checklist skill: run a focused pass over a diff for common defects (error handling, edge cases, naming, tests) before opening a PR. Installs a SKILL.md the agent can invoke.

plugins.name: Commit Helper
plugins.description: A subagent that drafts a conventional-commit message from a staged diff, respecting the repo's existing commit style. Installs an agent definition the CLI can delegate to.

plugins.name: VibeCrew Spec Writer
plugins.description: Product-manager subagent that writes a card's technical spec to SPEC.md. Delegated to by a pipeline's spec stage. Installs an agent definition both CLIs can delegate to; the model is chosen per call by the launching pipeline.

plugins.name: VibeCrew Planner
plugins.description: Planning subagent that turns a card's SPEC.md into a step-by-step IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md. Delegated to by a pipeline's plan stage. Installs an agent definition both CLIs can delegate to; the model is chosen per call by the launching pipeline.

plugins.name: VibeCrew Coder
plugins.description: Coding subagent that implements a card from its spec and plan, executing IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md step by step. Delegated to by a pipeline's code stage. Installs an agent definition both CLIs can delegate to; the model is chosen per call by the launching pipeline.

plugins.name: VibeCrew Reviewer
plugins.description: Read-only review subagent that walks a card's diff for common defects and reports findings grouped by severity. Delegated to by a pipeline's review stage. Installs an agent definition both CLIs can delegate to; the model is chosen per call by the launching pipeline.

plugins.name: VibeCrew Orchestrator
plugins.description: The board-driving orchestrator agent. Host-ticked: VibeCrew's runtime owns the timer and delivers each tick with a status digest; the agent reflects card status, closes finished workspaces, dispatches ready cards, nudges stalled ones, and replies with a CADENCE line. Installs an agent definition both CLIs can launch; arms no cron of its own.

plugins.name: VibeCrew Decider
plugins.description: Answers a coding agent's pending question prompt on the operator's behalf, grounded in the card/spec/plan. The orchestrator delegates to this on an explicit 'answer that questionnaire' request, so it ships alongside it — an orchestrator that can name a delegate it cannot reach is worse than one that never offers.
